Definition
[Compact mapping] 1. ch9:9.2.2-def-1\group Fixed Point Theorems A nonlinear mapping $A : X \to X$ is called compact provided for each bounded sequence $\{ u_k\} _{k=1}^{\infty }$ the sequence $\{ A[u_k]\} _{k=1}^{\infty }$ is precompact; that is, there exists a subsequence $\{ u_{k_j}\} _{j=1}^{\infty }$ such that $\{ A[u_{k_j}]\} _{j=1}^{\infty }$ converges in $X$.
